description: The unsigned transactions for a swap on the chain through Nordstern's aggregator (an approval of the router when paying with a token, then the route), with what it returns and the least it may. For a pair the caller wants but only holds ETH or USDG for: one plan_swap per missing side, then plan_ladder with to.atLeast as that side's amount. Nothing is signed here.

amount.description: how much of `from`, as a decimal string

from.description: ETH, USDG, a token symbol or address

to.description: ETH, USDG, a token symbol or address

name: plan_swap
title: Buy a side a plan needs, through Nordstern
